info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Interbank Relationship Management API
info.description: The Interbank Relationship Management API facilitates the management of interbank relationships, enabling seamless communication and transaction execution between financial institutions. This API allows users to create and manage external agency relationships, ensuring compliance and effective collaboration. Typically utilized by banks and financial service providers, it streamlines processes for onboarding and maintaining partnerships with external agencies. This enhances operational efficiency and supports the establishment of strategic alliances within the banking ecosystem.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to establish a new interbank relationship for external agencies. It involves sending the necessary details to create and manage relationships effectively. Ensure all required information is included in your request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update interbank relationships through the external agency interface. It contains all necessary details required for the operation, including identification, parameters, and any relevant metadata.
